title: A9 Operations — source ownership and decision memory ledger

directory.owner: Website Publishing and Source Directory — LIVE

source_observation.note: Point-in-time readback from connected Google Drive of active Sheets, not a permanent counter. One public project has show_status false; no implied classification. Completed is a listed status, not certified engineering acceptance.

decisions.decision: Astam buyer and land-feasibility resources owned by Field & Desk Library; Operations provides query-preserving redirects.
fact_sources: Resource Library v1.4.0 published public-safe files

decisions.decision: Mobile single-row clickable status chips; desktop status dropdown; one shared source-backed filter applies to map, site list, progress and instructions.
Each future Operations derivation or UX/release decision must record owning source, visibility policy, changed path, PR, QA and actual release, with open holds.

Use hybrid site navigation: Notification Center before Map on home; Daily Progress and Sources & History on separate same-site HTML routes. Selecting a site by map marker, directory or notification selector filters reviewed notifications. Hide unverified outstanding/closed claims. Preserve old anchors and existing Library redirects.
decisions.limitations: Source-reviewed notifications lack independently approved resolved/open state in public projection. UI category filters cannot be used to infer outstanding work.

decisions.decision: Clean site map above hidden-until-selection notification panel. Sticky independently scrolling desktop navigator; compact mobile site directory. Pin selects details without resetting map or hiding adjacent pins; explicit return, Escape, blank-map tap clear selection, pan/zoom retained. Integrate approved existing Companies and Organizations Sheet as public organization label authority and Website Publishing Source Directory as source pointer validator. Projects and Locations replaces historical Git identity as live source; do not publish private joined workbook tabs.
decisions.note: Data publication controlled by original Is Public, active VALID and Website Display Choices. No new editable Google Sheets created. Original private people/finances/source rows excluded.

decisions.decision: Repair iPhone overflow and inaccessible multi-link nav with compact sticky Menu and 16px touch input controls; retain former Daily Progress/Sources as reference routes. Add four-lane Extraction desk and read-only first-batch checkpoint from seven original Google Sheets; no new Slack/Discord/Telegram collection or source Sheet mutation.
decisions.notes: Historical original Git SHA v2.9.0 preserved; one versioned Slack source/22 reviewed notices; work status UNVERIFIED. Source data older than readback; no new verified rows to append.

decisions.decision: Remove large seven-link iPhone navigation and four-lane extraction display. Use direct three-tab Map/Notifications/Site updates; derive readable per-project meaning from approved notifications and historical Project Work through Actions. Preserve legacy audit routes, released tags, private evidence and same original Google Sheet IDs. Consolidate eight historical release jobs into one current milestone verifier.
decisions.limitations: No direct Slack, Discord or WhatsApp Actions collector. A reviewed instruction is not proof of open backlog, and work reports are not signed engineer completion.

decisions.decision: Separate approved Completed/Not required/Cancelled/Superseded notices and Project Work into read-only Closed & Archived Work page, preserving all public project map pins and original source rows. No unverified, unapproved or inferred closure may leave active feed. No original Sheet edits in this release.
decisions.limitations: Original Google Sheets lack Closure Decision/Approved/Date/Reviewer/Reason/Evidence fields; live archive therefore legitimately starts at zero. Source editors must add fields and append-only decision history with A7 PRE/POST process.
